video_title: Has The Wemby Era In NBA Started?!? + Why We Love EMOTIONAL Wemby!!

quotes.speaker: Chandler Parsons
quotes.summary_phrase: Spurs and Thunder are the future of the Western Conference
quotes.excerpt: I think this they could go back and forth the next five, six years.

text_blocks.speaker: Chandler Parsons
text_blocks.text: As far as if it's Wemby's West or not, listen, it was great. The fact that they did what they did, went on the road, Game 7, and knocked off the defending champs, it's unbelievable. But as Boogie just said, I think they could go back and forth the next five, six years. So is it his West? No, but I do think they are going to be there in contention, and the Oklahoma City Thunder are going to be just fine coming back with what they have fully healthy.

text_blocks.speaker: Chandler Parsons
text_blocks.text: Fully healthy. Let's not forget either, AJ Mitchell, Jalen Williams, those guys missed most of this season. Fully healthy, this could have looked quite differently. But the Spurs were great.

text_blocks.speaker: DeMarcus Cousins
text_blocks.text: Oh, I'm sorry. We talking about a Thunder team that only won last year because Shai Gilgeous-Alexander was hurt? I don't want to hear it.

text_blocks.speaker: Chandler Parsons
text_blocks.text: I'm just saying, listen, the Spurs are a replica of this Oklahoma City team. They are literally a clone that have found ways to beat them and match up with them and have successful have success against them with Wemby. So again, credit to them, and these two teams aren't going anywhere for a really long time.

quotes.speaker: Lou Williams
quotes.summary_phrase: Victor Wembanyama has entered the chat as a top young player
quotes.excerpt: Wemby has entered the chat along with some of the other great young players.
quotes.quote: There is some truth in this. Wemby has entered the chat along with some of the other great young players in the Western Conference. I agree with Chandler, I agree with Boogie. This is going to be a matchup we are going to see from years to come. I don't think Oklahoma City is going anywhere. For the first time in a couple of years, we have started to see that they are a strong basketball team, but they need everybody for them to be successful.

quotes.speaker: Lou Williams
quotes.summary_phrase: Stefan Castle was the anchor for the Spurs in Game 7
quotes.excerpt: Stefan Castle was like the anchor to this thing to me.
quotes.quote: You have to give all these guys credit. As much credit as we give Wemby, Stefan Castle was like the anchor to this thing to me. The toughness that you needed, the energy that you needed, somebody that was playing fearless that just didn't care, Stefan Castle was that. He is one of the younger guys on his team. Devin Vassell out of that starting lineup, he is the oldest at 25, and he was 30. He was somebody that you needed. His availability and his value was everything that this team needed. Champagnie, it felt like every time he shoots the basketball, it is going to be a made basket. De'Aaron Fox, that veteran leadership that you need. All of these guys, young Harper, coming off the bench, going in the starting lineup, whenever his number was called, he stepped up to the plate and he did what he was supposed to do.

quotes.speaker: DeMarcus Cousins
quotes.summary_phrase: The Spurs are a disciplined, young, and fearless team
quotes.excerpt: This is a very young, disciplined group. That's something that doesn't get talked about enough.
quotes.quote: This team has arrived and I think it's beyond the court for them. I think the experience starts with the organization. They know exactly what they're looking for in their personnel with each player that they bring into that organization. This is a very young, disciplined group. That's something that doesn't get talked about enough. Their discipline with being so young, that's something that isn't really shown until years later in the league when you do kind of gain that experience. But when it comes to that experience part, I actually think it kind of worked in reverse for them. They're so young and naive that it kind of cancels out the fear. You just go out there, you play freely, you play with no worry, kind of with that young mindset.
